free_tier.stated: Gone. The vendor's own notice states 'Untether AI Corp. has entered into a transaction with AMD. As a result of the transaction, Untether AI will no longer be supplying or supporting our speedAI products and imAIgine Software Development Kit (SDK)... today marks the end of Untether AI's journey.' The company filed for bankruptcy in Ontario on 2025-10-15 with USD 128,630,754 of liabilities against USD 24,958,914 of assets.

record.interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
record.chaining: Nothing chains. The hardware was never rentable from a third party cloud at a published rate, so there is no residue to chain with.
record.limits_note: nothing binds because nothing is sold or given: both the speedAI chips and the imAIgine SDK stopped being supplied.
